messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: triangular lattice perturbation with boundary defect correction

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Start from a 13-point triangular lattice inscribed in the unit square (approximately 4 rows of sizes 3-4-3-3), then apply boundary defect correction by moving the 3 corner points inward along the angle bisectors by a distance δ≈0.018, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 5/972≈0.005144. The optimal δ equalizes the smallest corner-adjacent triangles with the smallest interior lattice triangles, and the corrected configuration beats any purely periodic triangular lattice packing by at least 4%."}
